name: descentsVanish_hypSum
summary: Adding hyperbolic planes keeps the vanishing of descents (descentsVanish_add_planes) once the descents to W itself vanish, which follows from the reflection sums (descentsVanish_of_reflectionSum) and from θΞ = 0 through the edge property of the pair.

steps.claim: Record the action of the Weil representation on integrated data for the pair (W, I_n) with characters O.a, O.b (pairWeil_integrated).
steps.lean: have p := pairWeil_integrated O.W (stdSpace E n) O.a O.b

steps.claim: Rewrite h0: θΞ = 0 as the vanishing of a multiple of the conjugate of the swapped lift (theta_eq_smul_star_lift_swap).

Apply descentsVanish_add_planes (W ⊕ ℍ^N from W, n > 2r + 2N + 3, w split, the same set S): it suffices that the descents to W vanish for data that are the vacuum outside the places of O and their conjugates, which descentsVanish_of_reflectionSum gives from hQ and hM, using that the highest vector of the weight is cyclic (highestVector_cyclic, O.isHCParam_paramV) and that the Hecke polynomial at w annihilates the coefficient (from hH through map_heckePolyOp, Ξ spherical at w).
steps.lean:
refine' descentsVanish_add_planes (descentsVanish_of_reflectionSum _ hQ hM fun P ↦ funext fun g ↦
    highestVector_cyclic (O.isHCParam_paramV · |>.1) O.detExp (.proj g ∘ₗ liftBilin _ _ ∘ₗ ⟨⟨fun u ↦
    ⟨_, (isAutomorphic_star_algFormCoeff (gramForm u) Ξ).mem_rapidFunctions⟩, _⟩, _⟩) u
    (.inr fun x ↦ _)) (removePlanes ..) _ hw _ (by grind [star_star]) (by simp [funext_iff,
    ← algFormCoeff_algFormRep, ↓mem_levelSpace.1 (Ξ.mem_sphericalAt hS)]) _
    ((map_heckePolyOp ((starLinearEquiv ℂ).1 ∘ₛₗ _) _ (by simp [funext_iff,
    algFormCoeff_algFormRep])).symm.trans ((congrArg _ congr(($hH).1)).trans (map_zero _))) hn

steps.claim: Side goals: automorphy of the conjugate coefficient, the unramified character at w, the test value and the Frobenius values (simp).
steps.lean:
any_goals simp [↓isAutomorphic_star_algFormCoeff, algFormCoeff,
    funext_iff, ↓HasWeight.charUnramifiedAt, testValue, frobValue]

steps.claim: The remaining goal, that the lift of the coefficient through the pair vanishes, follows from h0: the lift of the coefficient through the swapped kernel equals the real convolution of the lift of Ξ (lift_omega_left, the edge property hO.isEdge.2.lift_isForm_and_eq_realConv, Ξ a form of the right type: isForm_ofAlgForm), which is 0.
steps.lean:
simpa [algFormCoeff_apply, ← gramForm_conjWeylRep (e := O.detExp) x (highestVector _ _),
    liftBilin, pairWeil_apply, realConv, lift, mul_left_comm _ _⁻¹, mul_assoc] using
    congrFun (((pairThetaKer ..).swap.lift_omega_left (isAutomorphic_star_algFormCoeff _ Ξ)
    (x⁻¹, 1)).symm.trans (congr(lift _ $(p ..) _).trans (((hO.isEdge.2.lift_isForm_and_eq_realConv _
    (by simp [realPairWeil_polyVector, negCount])).choose_spec _ (by simp [p])
    (isForm_ofAlgForm O.isHCParam_paramV Ξ.1).conj).2.trans (congrArg _ h0)))) g
